name: DataForSEO
summary: DataForSEO APIs: live and queued Google SERPs, keyword data, DataForSEO Labs and backlinks, billed per task in USD.

login.description: your DataForSEO API login (from the API Access page of your DataForSEO dashboard)

password.description: your DataForSEO API password (from the API Access page of your DataForSEO dashboard; not your web login password)

notes: Every POST takes a JSON ARRAY of task objects, e.g. [{"keyword": "...", "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}]; the params below describe one task object. Live calls accept one task per call.

Billing is prepaid in USD per task (the cost field of each answer); minimum top-up is $50 and new accounts get $1 trial credit. Prices vary by endpoint and mode: Google organic SERP is $0.0006 per SERP (standard queue), $0.0012 (priority) or $0.002 (live).
Live endpoints answer in one call (about 6 seconds for SERP); the queue pattern is task_post, then tasks_ready or a pingback, then task_get. Results are kept 30 days.
Answers wrap a tasks array; check each task's status_code and status_message as well as the HTTP status.
Most calls need a location and a language; give either the code or the full name of each. Valid values come from each product's locations and languages endpoints.

endpoints.name: Get account data
endpoints.summary: API usage, prices, spending and other account details.
notes: Free. Returned prices are the base cost per call; paid add-on parameters are not included.

endpoints.name: Live Google organic SERP
endpoints.summary: Full Google results page (organic, features, ads) for a keyword, location and language, returned in the same call.

keyword.description: The keyword, up to 700 characters. Operators like site: or intitle: multiply the charge by 5.

location_name.description: Full location name, such as London,England,United Kingdom. Use this or location_code.

location_code.description: Location code, such as 2840 for the United States. Use this or location_name.

language_name.description: Full language name, such as English. Use this or language_code.

language_code.description: Language code, such as en. Use this or language_name.

depth.description: Results to parse, default 10, maximum 200. Billed per 10 results.

os.description: Device OS: windows or macos for desktop, android or ios for mobile.

search_param.description: Extra Google query parameters, appended to the search.

se_domain.description: Search engine domain, such as google.co.uk; chosen from location and language if unset.

load_async_ai_overview.description: true loads AI overviews that appear asynchronously.

tag.description: Your own task label (up to 255 characters), echoed back in the result.

notes: Cost: $0.002 per SERP of up to 10 results in live mode; depth above 10 adds charges. Each call carries one task.
Needs one of location_name, location_code or location_coordinate, plus a language.
The body is sent as a one-task JSON array, as DataForSEO requires; one call is one task.

endpoints.name: Queue a Google organic SERP task
endpoints.summary: Queue a Google organic SERP task; collect it later by id. Cheaper than live.

location_name.description: Full location name, such as London,England,United Kingdom. Use this or location_code.

location_code.description: Location code, such as 2840 for the United States. Use this or location_name.

language_name.description: Full language name, such as English. Use this or language_code.

language_code.description: Language code, such as en. Use this or language_name.

pingback_url.description: URL DataForSEO calls with GET when the task completes; $id and $tag work as variables.

tag.description: Your own task label (up to 255 characters), echoed back in the result.

notes: Starts a job that only produces data; the call returns a task id. Fetch results with dataforseo.serp.google_organic_task_get, or list finished ids with the tasks_ready endpoint.
Cost: $0.0006 per SERP in the standard queue (about 5 minutes) or $0.0012 in the priority queue (about 1 minute).
The body is sent as a one-task JSON array, as DataForSEO requires; one call is one task.

endpoints.name: Get a queued SERP task
endpoints.summary: Results of a task queued with the Google organic task_post call.
notes: Free: you are charged only for posting the task. Results stay available for 30 days.

endpoints.name: Google Ads search volume
endpoints.summary: Monthly search volume, CPC, competition and bid ranges for up to 1,000 keywords from Google Ads data.

keywords.description: Up to 1,000 keywords, each at most 80 characters and 10 words; lowercased by the API.

location_name.description: Full location name, such as London,England,United Kingdom. Use this or location_code.

location_code.description: Location code, such as 2840 for the United States. Use this or location_name.

location_coordinate.description: GPS as latitude,longitude; data is for the country it falls in.

language_name.description: Full language name, such as English. Use this or language_code.

language_code.description: Language code, such as en. Use this or language_name.

search_partners.description: Include Google search partners. Default false.

date_from.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd; at most 4 years back. Default: past 12 months.

date_to.description: End date, yyyy-mm-dd; not later than last month. Default: yesterday.

sort_by.description: relevance (default), search_volume, competition_index, low_top_of_page_bid or high_top_of_page_bid; descending.

tag.description: Your own task label (up to 255 characters), echoed back in the result.

notes: Google Ads groups similar keywords into combined volumes; send close variants in separate calls to separate their volume. No location means worldwide data.
The body is sent as a one-task JSON array, as DataForSEO requires; one call is one task.
